visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with an exterior shot of a modern tofu specialty shop named 'MINGYUE TOFU'. Customers, including a woman in a bright red vest, walk toward the glass entrance. The setting is an urban street with bright daylight. (2) Inside the shop, a line of customers, mostly middle-aged women in casual attire, wait at a minimalist wooden counter. The lighting is warm and even, highlighting the clean retail environment. (3) A close-up shows an industrial metal machine processing cubes of fried tofu, which tumble down onto a tray. The tofu cubes are golden-brown with a rough, porous texture, appearing fresh and warm. (4) A pair of hands uses metal tongs to pick up several pieces of the soft fried tofu and place them into a clear plastic bag. The background shows more tofu in a green crate, emphasizing the shop's high volume. (5) The plastic bag of tofu is placed on a digital scale to be weighed. The hands then lift the bag in front of the store's signage, showing a successful purchase. (6) A single piece of fried tofu is held up by chopsticks. It is bitten into, revealing a soft, white, spongy interior contrasting with the golden outer skin. (7) A person's hand holds up a white and yellow package labeled 'TOFU SNACK'. The bag is opened to reveal thin, crispy tofu biscuits inside, scattered with black sesame seeds. (8) Tofu biscuits are poured into a white ceramic bowl. The biscuits are irregular in shape, light brown, and thin. The scene cuts to a close-up of a hand breaking a biscuit to show its crispness. (9) Sequential shots show different varieties of tofu biscuits being poured out, including a version with plum powder and a pepper-salt flavor. Each bowl is clean and minimalist against a neutral background. (10) A different bag labeled 'TOFU CHIPS' is presented. Large, round, thin baked tofu chips are poured out, showing a lighter, more translucent texture than the previous biscuits. (11) The scene shifts back to production, showing a staff member in a blue apron and mask pouring hot soy milk into a large industrial vat. The final shot returns to the storefront with people gathered outside.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly male narrator begins speaking in a warm, enthusiastic tone over a rhythmic acoustic guitar track. The BGM has a steady, mid-tempo feel. The narrator introduces a tofu specialty shop, with the voice sounding clear and well-recorded, characteristic of a studio environment. (2) A crisp, distinct 'crunch' sound effect triggers a new phase as biscuits are shown. The narration continues at a conversational pace, synchronized with the rhythmic strumming of the guitar. The acoustic environment is clean with minimal background hum. (3) The rustling sound of a plastic bag being opened and the light percussive 'clinking' of biscuits falling into a ceramic bowl are clearly audible. The music remains consistent in the background, providing an upbeat energy. The narrator's pitch rises slightly during the description of flavors. (4) A splashing sound of liquid being poured accompanies the visual of soy milk. The narrator concludes the review with a friendly sign-off. The audio maintains a high signal-to-noise ratio throughout, with the music fading out gently at the end.
